summary: Register a public loopback OAuth client in a sandbox environment you own, then sign a user up (verification email captured to the sandbox test-inbox) and in through the recipe's relying party.

params.name: workspaceSlug
params.prompt: Standing workspace slug (the workspace your session is bound to; NOT created)

params.name: envSlug
params.prompt: Slug for the sandbox environment the provision file creates (or adopts, if it already exists)

params.name: appName
params.prompt: Display name for the OAuth client

params.name: DEMO_USER_PASSWORD
params.prompt: Password for the demo user (feeds the provision file's passwordEnv; never stored)
